# `aitbc trade status`

Get the status of a specific trade.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--trade-id` | text | — | yes | Trade ID |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade status --trade-id <trade_id>
```
